title: EcoWattSense report
description: One report from one computer for one interval. Same shape alone and in a list. The names are the same in the database brief (docs/design/database-data-brief.md) and in the API contract (docs/design/api-contract.md).

device_id.description: The computer. A random UUID the client makes at its first start. It never changes.

timestamp.description: The end of the interval, in UTC with a zone, for example `2026-10-19T14:05:00Z`. A time without a zone is rejected.

interval_seconds.description: The seconds the report covers. It can be shorter than the setting, for example before sleep.

idle_seconds.description: Seconds since the last keyboard or mouse input.

screen_locked.description: True when the screen is locked.

on_battery.description: True when a laptop runs on its battery. A desktop always sends false.

device_type.description: For example `desktop` or `laptop`. More types can come later. It picks the row in `energy_rates`.

energy_uj.description: Energy taken from the wall socket in the interval, in microjoules. Only a client that can measure it sends it. On battery it is 0. When it is missing, the server estimates it from `energy_rates`, except when `on_battery` is true: then the server stores 0.

battery_energy_uj.description: Energy that went into the battery (above 0) or came out of it (below 0) in the interval, in microjoules. Only a client that can see the battery sends it. For analysis, not for cost.

device_energy_uj.description: Energy the computer used for its own work in the interval, from the grid or from the battery, in microjoules. For analysis, not for cost.

machine_hash.description: SHA-256 of a hardware id, in lower case hex. A fingerprint, so the admin can see that two device ids are the same machine. Optional.
